name: lawyer-meetings
description: Prepares meeting notes for your lawyer from your documents and account of events. Builds a document list, a sourced timeline, disputed accounts, gaps, questions and a concise agenda. Turns supplied meeting notes into actions, owners and open questions. Works from authorized files or pasted text; no accounts or paid APIs. Not legal advice, signing recommendations, lawsuit planning, privilege guarantees or court-deadline calculations.
